<thought>Based on the 13C NMR data, methyl carbons appear at low ppm. Peaks at 26.40 ppm, 58.70 ppm (typical for an O‑CH₃), and a pair of identical peaks at 36.40 ppm (indicating two equivalent methyl groups) are observed. This corresponds to a total of 4 methyl (CH₃) groups.</thought>
<final_answer>4</final_answer>
